question.text: How should firms in a service cluster cooperate in waiting-area entertainment investment while competing on other service dimensions?

source.quote:
A service cluster with a common space provides ﬁrms with an opportunity
to cooperate in the investment for providing entertainment options while competing on
other service dimensions.

overview.text: Using a queueing model, the paper studies waiting-area entertainment in a service cluster through a focal co-opetition model and separate local-monopoly and duopoly-competition benchmarks.

sources.quote:

queueing theoretic approach, we develop a parsimonious model of co-opetition in a service
cluster with a common space.
